name: Gateway of India
description: The basalt arch on the Apollo Bunder waterfront. Get there before 7am to shoot it without the crowds, with the Taj Mahal Palace framing the left edge.

name: Marine Drive
description: The Queen's Necklace. The curve of streetlights reads best from the Girgaum Chowpatty end about twenty minutes after sunset.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
description: Victorian Gothic railway station, floodlit after dark. The wide view is from the traffic island opposite the main facade.

name: Bandra-Worli Sea Link
description: Cable-stayed bridge across Mahim Bay. Shoot the cable geometry from Bandra Bandstand or the Worli Sea Face promenade.

name: Haji Ali Dargah
description: White marble shrine on an islet, reached by a causeway that floods at high tide. Check the tide chart before walking out.

name: Banganga Tank
description: Ancient stepped water tank tucked behind Walkeshwar. Soft light reaches the steps late; mornings give the best reflections.

name: Global Vipassana Pagoda
description: Golden dome near Gorai Creek, reached by ferry. The gilding holds colour even under harsh overhead sun.

name: Elephanta Caves
description: Rock-cut cave temples on Gharapuri Island. Bring a fast lens - the Trimurti chamber is much darker than it looks.

name: Kanheri Caves
description: Buddhist caves cut into a basalt ridge inside Sanjay Gandhi National Park. Side light rakes across the prayer hall pillars early.

name: Sanjay Gandhi National Park
description: Forest inside the city limits. Mist through the canopy after monsoon rain is the shot worth waiting for.

name: Flora Fountain
description: Carved Portland stone fountain at Hutatma Chowk. Warm evening light plus long exposures on the traffic works well here.

name: Bandra Fort (Castella de Aguada)
description: Portuguese watchtower ruin looking out over the Sea Link. The stone arches make a natural frame for the bridge.

name: Dhobi Ghat
description: Open-air laundry at Mahalaxmi, best seen from the bridge above. Ask before photographing people at work.

name: Worli Fort
description: Small hilltop fort above Worli Koliwada fishing village, with the Sea Link sweeping across the background.

name: Siddhivinayak Temple
description: Domed Ganesh temple in Prabhadevi, gopuram-style spire against open sky. Arrive before the queues build up for a clean shot of the facade.

name: Rajabai Clock Tower
description: Venetian Gothic clock tower on the Fort campus of Mumbai University. Shoot from across the Oval Maidan so the palms frame the base.

name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya
description: Indo-Saracenic domed museum building (formerly Prince of Wales Museum), fronted by a palm-lined lawn in Kala Ghoda.

name: Hanging Gardens
description: Terraced hedge garden on Malabar Hill, across the road from Kamala Nehru Park. West-facing, so it catches the sunset over the Arabian Sea.

name: Girgaon Chowpatty
description: The beach at the southern end of Marine Drive - kite flyers, bhelpuri stalls and the Queen's Necklace lighting up as the sky turns.

name: Juhu Beach
description: Long suburban beach backed by the northern skyline. Wide and uncrowded enough for a clean horizon shot outside weekend evenings.

name: Horniman Circle Garden
description: Circular colonial-era garden ringed by Fort's grandest facades. Quiet and shaded before the office crowds arrive for lunch.
commons_file: A bench in Horniman Circle Garden, Mumbai.jpg

name: Mount Mary Church
description: Twin-spired basilica on a hilltop above Bandra, overlooking the sea. The facade catches warm light well before sunset.

name: Mahim Fort
description: Seafront ruin at the mouth of Mahim Bay, with a clear line of sight to the Bandra-Worli Sea Link across the water.

name: St. Thomas Cathedral
description: Mumbai's oldest Anglican church, tucked behind Horniman Circle. Soft light through the stained glass works best a couple of hours after sunrise.

name: Mani Bhavan
description: Gandhi's Mumbai residence from 1917 to 1934, now a small museum on a quiet Gamdevi lane.
commons_file: Mani Bhavan - Gandhi's house in Mumbai.jpg

name: Dr. Bhau Daji Lad Museum
description: Palladian-style museum building inside Byculla's Rani Baug, restored down to its cast-iron detailing.
commons_file: Dr. Bhau Daji Lad Museum, esterno 01.jpg

name: Knesset Eliyahoo Synagogue
description: Sky-blue Sephardic synagogue on a Kala Ghoda side street, one of the most photographed facades in Fort.

name: Gilbert Hill
description: A 200-foot basalt monolith rising straight out of an Andheri suburb - one of the few of its kind outside the US.

name: Mahakali Caves
description: Rock-cut Buddhist caves from the 1st century BCE, incongruously wedged behind an Andheri East IT park.

name: Aksa Beach
description: A long, quieter stretch of sand out in Malad, backed by palms, with the Madh Fort headland visible up the coast.

name: Versova Beach
description: Fishing-village beach with a working Koli harbour at one end - come early to catch the boats going out.

name: Marvé Beach
description: Quiet creek-side beach facing Manori across the water, with the passenger ferry jetty at one end.

name: Manori
description: A coastal village reached by a short ferry ride, with palm groves and a working fishing harbour untouched by the city rush.

name: Powai Lake
description: Artificial lake ringed by high-rises, with the forested hills of Sanjay Gandhi National Park behind it.
commons_file: Powai lake as seen from Ambedkar Garden, mumbai.jpg

name: Hiranandani Gardens
description: A Mediterranean-styled planned township in Powai, built around a piazza and colonnaded facades.

name: Bandra Talao
description: A small lake and garden tucked into a residential Bandra lane, easy to walk past without noticing.

name: Sewri Fort
description: 17th-century fort overlooking the Sewri mudflats, famous every winter for the flamingos that gather just offshore.

name: Sion Hillock Fort
description: A small hilltop fort with an open view across Sion and the Dharavi rooftops below.

name: Belapur Fort
description: Maratha-era fort ruins on a rise above Thane Creek, on the quieter Navi Mumbai side of the harbour.

name: Central Park, Kharghar
description: A large landscaped park with a musical fountain and open lawns, one of Navi Mumbai's biggest green spaces.

name: Kharghar
description: A planned Navi Mumbai node known for its wide avenues and hillside views, centred around Utsav Chowk.

name: Palm Beach Road
description: A waterfront boulevard tracing Thane Creek between Vashi and Belapur, good for the skyline across the water at dusk.
commons_file: Buildings along the Palm Beach Road.JPG

name: DY Patil Stadium
description: A large modern cricket and football stadium in Nerul, its tiered stands visible from well outside the ground.

name: Navi Mumbai Skyline
description: High-rise skyline view from Vashi, Navi Mumbai's original planned node, across the water from the mainland.
